author: Zedther
body:
Hello.
GibboDaMan was being very disgraceful towards Howsie, implying he never did anything for the server on the thread http://avicus.net/forums/3eae6f7c9?page=1, he was then acting quite negative towards SweetMango, stating that people aren't allowed to use their opinions anymore.
He then continued to imply the senior staff team wasn't doing any work.
This should not be tolerated, and action should be taken.
Thanks
-eddy <3
